title: Quick Mediterranean Cocoa Mousse
description: A vegan, airy cocoa mousse with Mediterranean flair, sweetened with caster sugar and tempered dark chocolate for a bouncy, glossy finish.
instructions: Place chocolate in a heat-proof bowl over a pot of simmering water; stir until melted.
Remove from heat and let the chocolate cool to 45C while stirring occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whisk coconut milk, caster sugar, vanilla and a pinch of salt until the sugar dissolves.
Gently fold the melted chocolate into the coconut mixture until fully incorporated.
Transfer the mixture to individual serving glasses and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Before serving, garnish each mousse with a sprinkle of crushed dark chocolate.
Serve chilled and enjoy the airy Mediterranean cocoa mousse.
